notes.title: Demo Updated - Bug Fixes 1.02
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated UI elements
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Aim meter not appearing when casting Fireball
[*] Game freezing when casting Concentrate + Fireball and there are more than 2 targets
[*] Concentrate + Firepillar damaging Sprigg
[*] Sprigg animation stuttering when facing north
[*] Being able to undo a move after moving then casting an ability or using an item
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Updated UI components
- Adjusted the timing of Meteor when using it in combination with Concentrate

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Practice enemies disappear on KO
- Self-damaging abilities weren't self-damaging
- A concentrated fireball with 4 targets was freezing the match
- Passive ability text errors on PC

notes.title: 0.88 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Character equip screen wasn't displaying correctly 
[*] Item shop timer wasn't counting down or refreshing correctly
[*] Friends list has been redesigned, and user ID's have been removed. You can now add friends by their Username and hashtag number assigned at account creation.
[*] Adjusted some PC UI positioning
[/list]

It's highly recommended that you delete your old account, as the way usernames are structured and created has changed. Using accounts from pre-0.88 versions will likely result in bugs. You can delete your account by opening the settings menu and pressing the delete forever button.
